title: spec(ui): page action rows still accept five declarative-update shapes `ActionSchema` refuses (`patch` without `operation`; `update` with `target`, a `url` executor, no `patch`, or `list_toolbar`): family closing card after #23332
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): one operation, two implementations that disagree. This is the closing card for the family "page action rows vs `ActionSchema` on the declarative-update mixing rule". Its first member, #23332 (`onSuccess` beside `operation: 'update'`), closes with PR #23425; this card carries every remaining member, enumerated below.

`reach:` `os validate`'s props gate parses page action rows against these row schemas, so each shape below passes `os validate` on a page while the same action is refused by `defineAction`/`ActionSchema`. Static repro by PR #23425's dev on the built spec dist at `339604baf`; source: the #23332 dev report `6163790103`, `out_of_scope_findings` entry 1. Not re-measured by the seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`, at PR #23425's review. ⛔ Not a claim; grading and routing are triage's.

## The members (row accepts, `ActionSchema` refuses at)

| # | shape on `action:button` (same for `action:icon`, group/menu members) | `ActionSchema` refuses at |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `patch` without `operation` | `patch` |
| 2 | `operation: 'update'` + `target` | `target` |
| 3 | `operation: 'update'` + `actionType: 'url'` | `type`, `target` |
| 4 | `operation: 'update'` with no `patch` (or `params`) | `patch` |
| 5 | `operation: 'update'` + `locations: ['list_toolbar']` | `locations.0` |

The enumeration nail: `ActionSchema`'s `DECLARATIVE_UPDATE_REFUSED_KEYS` and the declarative-update refinements in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` are the full rule set; the claimant lists every rule there and gives each one a verdict on the rows (carried, not applicable to a row, or a deliberate difference with its reason), so no member is left for a later point card.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat that claims it (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, after PR #23425 lands, which introduces the rows' `operation` enum and the shared `onSuccess` text this card builds on). The direction #23332 took (triage `6154972534`, #23168 answer C `6148462268`): the rows carry `ActionSchema`'s rule exactly, read from one place.

Blocked-by: #23332
